images.author: Charmain Jansen van Rensburg
images.why: Strongest documented resolution: 6960 × 4640. Standing eland in open grassland, warm tawny colours and visible horns; source explicitly tags Taurotragus oryx.

images.author: Joubert de Wet
images.why: Mature bull with substantial dewlap and spiral horns in dry grassland. Source identifies common eland scientifically; original pixel dimensions were not available.

images.author: Teodor Angelov Tondina
images.why: Grazing eland in sunlit grassland with a leafy background; source explicitly tags Taurotragus oryx. Less imposing than an alert bull; dimensions and precise location unverified.

images.author: Gary Faulkner
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies Common Eland—Taurotragus oryx—and a wild Serengeti encounter. Linked 1024-pixel size falls below the preferred resolution; larger download unverified.

images.author: Gary Faulkner
images.why: Separate photograph explicitly identified as Taurotragus oryx in Serengeti National Park. Linked 1024-pixel size is a resolution compromise; full-body crop suitability unverified.

images.author: PW_Photography
images.why: Caption explicitly confirms common eland, Taurotragus oryx, in central Serengeti. Linked 1024-pixel size is below preference; sex and larger-file availability unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies a male common eland with oxpeckers; pronounced horns and dewlap provide strong species recognition. Photograph credit, dimensions and exact location are unstated.

images.author: matt-travels
images.why: Firsthand photographs explicitly identified as Taurotragus oryx in Etosha National Park. Wild provenance is documented; adult-male status, dimensions and 9:10 crop suitability remain unverified.

images.author: Matthew Stephenson
images.why: Standing bull with broad antlers, warm light and golden grass at a forest edge. Source names bull moose and records camera metadata; 3000-pixel download.

images.author: Matthew Stephenson
images.why: Walking bull in natural grassland with a forest backdrop; strong body silhouette and antlers. Source explicitly identifies bull moose; 3000-pixel download.

images.author: Matthew Stephenson
images.why: Large palmate antlers and warm vegetation make a strong poster subject. Source identifies moose and records camera metadata; brush partly obscures the legs.

images.author: Tom Koerner / USFWS
images.why: 3564 × 2689 original of a wild bull crossing the Green River. Official species ID is Alces alces shirasi; attractive wetland setting, with lower legs submerged.

images.author: NPS / Kelly Morrissey
images.why: 5184 × 3456 original showing a large bull standing on a forest trail at Isle Royale. Official caption confirms bull moose; antlers are in velvet and lighting is subdued.

images.author: Gundula Vogel
images.why: Caption identifies a bull moose in a grassy meadow with forest behind it; location is Canada. Green habitat provides colour contrast; exact dimensions and wild provenance unverified.

images.author: Camerauthor Photos
images.why: Photographer captions it 'Bull Moose' in Northern Ontario and supplies Canon camera metadata. Autumn habitat and visible antlers; tall vegetation obscures some of the body.

images.author: Matthew Stephenson
images.why: Source explicitly identifies a walking bull moose among brush and trees. Natural forest context and broad antlers; 3000-pixel download, with a busier background.
